methods.label: Subtract the exponents
methods.explanation: When dividing powers with the same base, keep the base unchanged and subtract the exponents: \(8-3=5\). The result is \(x^5\).
methods.levelReason: Directly applies the Grade 8 rule for dividing powers with the same nonzero base.
